question: For veg whsle data, can you analyze our financial performance over the years 2020 to 2023? I need insights into the average wholesale price, maximum wholesale price, minimum wholesale price, wholesale price difference, total wholesale price, total selling price, average loss rate, total loss, and profit for each category within each year. Round all calculated values to two decimal places.
sql:
WITH wholesale_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        c.category_name,
        TRY_CAST(SUBSTR(w.whsle_date, 1, 4) AS BIGINT) as year,
        AVG(w."whsle_px_rmb-kg") as avg_wholesale_price,
        MAX(w."whsle_px_rmb-kg") as max_wholesale_price,
        MIN(w."whsle_px_rmb-kg") as min_wholesale_price,
        MAX(w."whsle_px_rmb-kg") - MIN(w."whsle_px_rmb-kg") as wholesale_price_diff,
        SUM(w."whsle_px_rmb-kg") as total_wholesale_price,
        AVG(l."loss_rate_%") as avg_loss_rate
    FROM veg_whsle_df w
    JOIN veg_cat c ON w.item_code = c.item_code
    LEFT JOIN veg_loss_rate_df l ON w.item_code = l.item_code
    WHERE TRY_CAST(SUBSTR(w.whsle_date, 1, 4) AS BIGINT) BETWEEN 2020 AND 2023
    GROUP BY c.category_name, TRY_CAST(SUBSTR(w.whsle_date, 1, 4) AS BIGINT)
),
selling_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        c.category_name,
        TRY_CAST(SUBSTR(t.txn_date, 1, 4) AS BIGINT) as year,
        SUM(t."qty_sold(kg)" * t."unit_selling_px_rmb/kg") as total_selling_price
    FROM veg_txn_df t
    JOIN veg_cat c ON t.item_code = c.item_code
    WHERE t."sale/return" = 'sale'
      AND TRY_CAST(SUBSTR(t.txn_date, 1, 4) AS BIGINT) BETWEEN 2020 AND 2023
    GROUP BY c.category_name, TRY_CAST(SUBSTR(t.txn_date, 1, 4) AS BIGINT)
),
avg_loss_by_category AS (
    SELECT 
        c.category_name,
        AVG(l."loss_rate_%") as avg_loss_rate
    FROM veg_loss_rate_df l
    JOIN veg_cat c ON l.item_code = c.item_code
    GROUP BY c.category_name
)
SELECT 
    wm.category_name,
    wm.year,
    ROUND(wm.avg_wholesale_price, 2) as avg_wholesale_price,
    ROUND(wm.max_wholesale_price, 2) as max_wholesale_price,
    ROUND(wm.min_wholesale_price, 2) as min_wholesale_price,
    ROUND(wm.wholesale_price_diff, 2) as wholesale_price_diff,
    ROUND(wm.total_wholesale_price, 2) as total_wholesale_price,
    ROUND(sm.total_selling_price, 2) as total_selling_price,
    ROUND(wm.avg_loss_rate, 2) as avg_loss_rate,
    ROUND(wm.total_wholesale_price * (wm.avg_loss_rate / 100.0), 2) as total_loss,
    ROUND(sm.total_selling_price - wm.total_wholesale_price - (wm.total_wholesale_price * (wm.avg_loss_rate / 100.0)), 2) as profit
FROM wholesale_metrics wm
JOIN selling_metrics sm ON wm.category_name = sm.category_name AND wm.year = sm.year
JOIN avg_loss_by_category alc ON wm.category_name = alc.category_name
ORDER BY wm.year, wm.category_name

      AND TRY_CAST(SUBSTR(t.txn_date, 1, 4) AS BIGINT) BETWEEN 2020 AND 2023
    GROUP BY c.category_name, TRY_CAST(SUBSTR(t.txn_date, 1, 4) AS BIGINT)
),
avg_loss_by_category AS (
    SELECT 
        c.category_name,
        AVG(l."loss_rate_%") as avg_loss_rate
    FROM veg_loss_rate_df l
    JOIN veg_cat c ON l.item_code = c.item_code
    GROUP BY c.category_name
)
SELECT 
    wm.category_name,
    wm.year,
    ROUND(wm.avg_wholesale_price, 2) as avg_wholesale_price,
    ROUND(wm.max_wholesale_price, 2) as max_wholesale_price,
    ROUND(wm.min_wholesale_price, 2) as min_wholesale_price,
    ROUND(wm.wholesale_price_diff, 2) as wholesale_price_diff,
    ROUND(wm.total_wholesale_price, 2) as total_wholesale_price,
    ROUND(sm.total_selling_price, 2) as total_selling_price,
    ROUND(wm.avg_loss_rate, 2) as avg_loss_rate,
    ROUND(wm.total_wholesale_price * (wm.avg_loss_rate / 100.0), 2) as total_loss,
    ROUND(sm.total_selling_price - wm.total_wholesale_price - (wm.total_wholesale_price * (wm.avg_loss_rate / 100.0)), 2) as profit
FROM wholesale_metrics wm
JOIN selling_metrics sm ON wm.category_name = sm.category_name AND wm.year = sm.year
JOIN avg_loss_by_category alc ON wm.category_name = alc.category_name
ORDER BY wm.year, wm.category_name
